company_notes: MAJOR CORRECTION plus a departure. The acquirer on file is 'Xerox' - that is WRONG. XDOS was a Xerox Authorized Sales Agency, never Xerox-owned, and it was acquired by LEVIFI, announced January 2025 (levifi.com/levifi-acquires-xdos-inc/; Industry Analysts 31 Jan 2025; The Sumter Item, 'Levifi acquires XDOS Inc., bringing workplace technology full circle for CEO'). Per the coverage, Levifi acquired 'XDOS Inc., a Xerox sales agency and dealership with offices in Sumter and Florence, SC' - Levifi's seventh acquisition, and full circle for founder Thomas Fimian, who started his career at XDOS in 1997 before founding Levifi in 2002. Company history from the dealer's own site xdosinc.com/about-xdos: created 1 Jan 1990 by Harold R. Nixon as the Xerox agency for Sumter, Clarendon, Orangeburg and Calhoun counties, originally Graphic Office Systems, renamed XDOS (Xerox Digital Office Solutions) in 1999, expanded to XDOS Pee Dee in Florence SC in Jan 2000, and 'In March of 2012, Faye Nixon became majority owner of XDOS, Inc.' - a woman-owned business. NEEDS A HUMAN DECISION: HubSpot contact 132373545540, Harold Nixon, 'Agent Owner', hnixon@xdosinc.com - the Levifi release names him explicitly as 'Harold Nixon, former owner of XDOS Inc.', so that title is now historic and the contact needs a departure/former-owner flag rather than being mailed as the owner.
